limitations: Uniform independent binary symbols; only two distinct fixed pure-burst lengths; does not cover nonbinary/biased distributions, three-lag observations or nonconsecutive deletion. General theorem proved by graph-character orthogonality; exhaustive checks are finite corroboration.
scientific_integrity: Single-lag counting and binomiality are known and cited; originality relates exclusively to the two-lag threshold and first joint law. All scientific checks are same-model only; no independent validation is asserted.
title: Sharp arithmetic independence threshold for two binary burst-deletion ball sizes
